conclusion: The local Nordkalottleden packet is internally consistent for the 12-section Kilpisjarvi-Reisa-Kautokeino sector, and a source-backed full-route section model now exists in full-route-section-model.research.json. Runtime import should still wait until the missing section packets, official-source geometry, facilities, rule warnings and shared-trail splits are normalized.

localCoverage.scope: Kilpisjarvi / Saarijarvi / Reisa / Kautokeino northern sector
notes: The 12-section model follows the Reisa National Park Kilpisjarvi-Kautokeino hut/distance inventory.
Generated candidate geometry uses Luontoon/Metsahallitus linework for Finnish legs, Geonorge/Turrutebasen linework for Norwegian legs, and a mixed official-source handoff for Kopmajoki-Somashytta.

Endpoint policies for Saarijarvi, Saraelv/Ovi Raishiin, Madam Bongos/Cunovuohppi, and the mixed source-boundary junction are explicit in the normalized candidate topology, but they only resolve the scoped northern sector.
The 2026-04-30 full-route model prefers Kautokeino-Sulitjelma as the mainline and Kvikkjokk-Sulitjelma as a separate southern variant.

recommendedNextSlice.goal: Turn the full-route section model into import-grade candidate data before importing Nordkalottleden.
steps: Generate section research packets for full-route-section-model.research.json mainline orders 13-44 and variant orders K1-K5.

Research central/south missing sections in batches using official regional sources first: Laponia/Naturkartan for Sweden, Luontoon/Metsähallitus for Finland, and UT/DNT/Geonorge/Kartverket for Norway.
For any sections that overlap existing Kungsleden or Padjelantaleden data, reuse geometry only after confirming source identity, endpoint semantics, and facility/rule text fit Nordkalottleden.
Generate candidate geometry for every full-route section and rerun candidate normalization before runtime import.
Only then add Nordkalottleden to the runtime importer.
